messages:
Sophia (PM): Heads-up — Q2 roadmap sync. We need to pick our primary bet for Hosted API: prioritize embedding precision for rerank accuracy, or optimize for cost/throughput. Customers are split and sales needs a clear ask by Monday. Quick take?

Matt (Eng): Short answer — can we run an opt-in A/B for 4 weeks and measure customer-facing metrics? Low-risk way to gather real signals.

Kai (ML): From ML side: small int8-ish quantization gives ~20% infra cost reduction but ~4–6% rerank MRR delta on some datasets. We have eval curves showing a sharp knee at certain dims. Need per-customer thresholds; not one-size-fits-all.

Anya (Product): We have 3 enterprise deals explicitly asking for deterministic higher-precision outputs. They'll accept a higher price (dedicated capacity). Proposal: two-track product: hosted default = cost-optimized; "Precision Tier" = paid dedicated + stricter model.

Oliver (Data): Also worth calling out embedding dimension choices: 1536 vs 1024 vs 768. 1536 improves recall for long-context rerank but ~1.6x token/cost. Could expose dim as a knob per route.

Sophia (PM): Proposed launch gates (minimal):
- Eval harness: precision on canonical rerank prompts >= baseline - 2%
- Perf: default config supports >=10k reqs/min sustained without queuing
- Canary: feature flag + 2-week canary + opt-in for customers
- Docs & pricing: pricing/packaging decision doc approved by GTM
Thoughts?

Matt (Eng): Add automation gate: detector for rerank quality drift (24h window) with auto-rollback. Also need per-route token distribution logging before wide rollout.

Kai (ML): I'll upload the eval curves and a sweep script. Small snippet I'll share for the team: ```python
# quick eval runner
def run_eval(model, dataset):
    # runs our rerank eval harness and emits PR-style report
    pass
```

Anya (Product): @Matt @Kai can you own the canary plan + docs? I'll own pricing language and sales enablement.

Matt (Eng): :thumbsup: I can do canary infra and rollout. Suggest 2-week canary starting at 5% traffic, step to 20% if no regression.

Sophia (PM): Great — I'll fold this into the Q2 OKR doc and sync with Growth + Solutions on Monday. Thanks everyone.
